source_issue.title: Add Plone documentation to sites that attract first-time contributors

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on improving Plone documentation to attract first-time contributors. Inspired by a model used in the icalendar project, it aims to create a welcoming environment for newcomers.

## What needs to be done
1. Update the documentation to include information about this pilot program.
2. Consider adding non-code contributions like translations or tutorials.
3. Follow up on the Good First Issue application, which is currently awaiting feedback.

## Helpful background
The project has received acceptance into the "Up For Grabs" initiative, which helps identify beginner-friendly tasks. However, there is some uncertainty regarding the status with "Good First Issue", as the discussion is still ongoing.

## Good first steps
- Familiarize yourself with the [Up For Grabs site](https://up-for-grabs.net/#/filters?tags=ical%2Cicalendar%2Cics%2Crfc5545) for context.
- Join the conversation about enhancing the documentation.
- Consider contributing any low or non-code tasks as mentioned in the Hacktoberfest guidelines.

Feel free to ask questions if you are uncertain about any part of the process!
```
